svg.title: From failure condition to primitive
svg.desc: Six structural failure conditions, each paired with the primitive that avoids it: reward ambiguity needs Objective Tracking, absorbing traps need Cross-Context Safety Transfer, local optima need Global Attractor Exploration, deterministic optimality needs Policy Simplification, constrained feasibility needs Feasibility Projection, and nonstationarity needs Feedback Adaptation. An environment exhibiting at least one of the six is in Class C.

svg.text: Each primitive has a matching structural failure mode; the environments built in Phase3.lean are the minimal instance of each.
